longTitle.officialTitle: To provide for donor contribution acknowledgments to be displayed at the Vietnam Veterans Memorial Visitor Center, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Vietnam Veterans Donor Acknowledgment Act of 2013”.

section.heading: DONOR CONTRIBUTION ACKNOWLEDGMENTS AT THE VIETNAM VETERANS MEMORIAL VISITOR CENTER.
section.chapeau: Section 6(b) of Public Law 96-297 (16 U.S.C. 431 note) is amended—
